name: prompt-manager.skill-set-read
purpose: Read one scenario's skill set as prompt-manager's registry sees it: ids registered under the scenario pack, usage and improve presence, token size, and read counts when skill-usage answers.

scenario.description: Scenario whose skill set is read; usage id is <scenario>, improve id is <scenario>-improve.

assumptions: prompt-manager is running and its skill bindings are reachable from the kernel
the skill-usage binding returns 500 (proto field projected unknown) as of 2026-09-02, so read-counts reads unavailable until that is fixed
an unavailable row is unknown, never zero
invariants: no binding with effect write or destructive is called
at most 50 registry rows per filter are read with head
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path

signals.rows: list of {row, reading, unavailable, reason}: registered-under-scenario-pack, usage-id-present, improve-id-present, set-token-size, read-counts
signals.unavailable: count of rows not readable in-program
signals.registered: skill ids the registry attributes to the scenario

outputs.evidence: sensor command names, one per row
